```{r}
# Load and process DEMs
library(purrr)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(units)
library(raster)
library(rgeos)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# delineated watersheds
watershed70 <- read_sf("Raw_Data/Shape_files/catchment_delineation/RefElv.shp")
```

```{r}


readandproject = function(x){
  lapply(x, function(x){
    r = rast(x)
    crs(r) = "EPSG:25833"
    r_crop <- crop(r, vect(watershed70))
    r_crop2 <- mask(r_crop, vect(watershed70))
    r_proj <- terra::aggregate(r_crop2, fact = 2)
    return(r_proj)
  }
  )
}

```

```{r}
list_of_files <- list.files(path = "Raw_Data/DEM/",
                            pattern='\\.tif$', full.names=TRUE)

y <- purrr::map(list_of_files, readandproject) 

rsrc <- sprc(unlist(y))
m <- mosaic(rsrc)

saveRDS(m, "Raw_Data/DEM/Output/dem_all.RData")
writeRaster(m, "Raw_Data/DEM/Output/dem_all.tif")
```
